MYSTS2MOD-HAO_POWER.title: Hao
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_POWER.description: When you take unblocked damage, lose all Hao, then take damage equal to the amount lost.
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_POWER.smartDescription: Current Hao: [blue]{Amount}[/blue]. When you take unblocked damage, lose all Hao, then take damage equal to the amount lost. HP loss does not trigger this effect.
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT_POWER.title: Shanghai Student
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT_POWER.descri: Whenever you play a card, gain 1 Hao and Block equal to this power's amount. Removed at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT_POWER.smartD: Whenever you play a card, gain 1 Hao and [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Block. Removed at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER_POWER.title: Sneer
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER_POWER.description: When you block damage from an enemy, deal damage equal to the amount blocked back to that enemy. Removed at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER_POWER.smartDescription: When you block damage from an enemy, deal damage equal to the amount blocked back to that enemy. Removed at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680_POWER.title: Equal 680
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680_POWER.description: While your Max HP is lower than the target enemy's, you deal 3 additional damage.
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680_POWER.smartDescriptio: While your Max HP is lower than the target enemy's, you deal 3 additional damage.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_GUARD_POWER.title: Unrepentant
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_GUARD_POWER.descri: Until the start of your next turn, damage consumes Block normally, but the remaining damage is converted into equal Hao instead of HP loss. At that point, this power is replaced with Unrepentant Aftermath.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_GUARD_POWER.smartD: Until the start of your next turn, damage consumes Block normally, but the remaining damage is converted into equal Hao instead of HP loss. At that point, this power is replaced with Unrepentant Aftermath.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_PAIN_POWER.title: Unrepentant Aftermath
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_PAIN_POWER.descrip: Whenever you play a card, take 2 blockable damage. Removed at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT_PAIN_POWER.smartDe: Whenever you play a card, take 2 blockable damage. Removed at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS_POWER.title: Genius
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 energy and draw cards equal to this power's amount. After you lose Hao, the next damage from an enemy is doubled; fully blocking it still consumes the effect.
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, gain 1 energy and draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] card(s). After you lose Hao, the next damage from an enemy is doubled; fully blocking it still consumes the effect.
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_DRAW_POWER.title: Magnificent Hao (Draw)
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_DRAW_POWER.descrip: Gain 1 Hao for every 2 cards drawn. This power starts with 1 card already counted. At the end of your turn, it is replaced with Magnificent Hao (Hao).
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_DRAW_POWER.smartDe: Gain 1 Hao for every 2 cards drawn. Current draw count: [blue]{Amount}[/blue]/2. At the end of your turn, this power is replaced with Magnificent Hao (Hao).
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO_POWER.title: Magnificent Hao (Hao)
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO_POWER.descript: Draw 1 card every 2 times you gain Hao. This power starts with 1 gain already counted. Removed at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO_POWER.smartDes: Draw 1 card every 2 times you gain Hao. Current gain count: [blue]{Amount}[/blue]/2. Removed at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE_POWER.title: Math Prince
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 temporary Strength for every 4 Hao you have. Lose that Strength at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE_POWER.smartDescrip: At the start of your turn, gain 1 temporary Strength for every 4 Hao you have. Lose that Strength at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD_POWER.title: Super Hao Field
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD_POWER.descript: At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to half your Hao (rounded down) and deal that much damage to ALL enemies.
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD_POWER.smartDes: At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to half your Hao (rounded down) and deal that much damage to ALL enemies.
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM_POWER.title: Tsinghua Form
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM_POWER.descriptio: Whenever you lose Hao, regain half the amount lost (rounded down) and gain that much Block.
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM_POWER.smartDescr: Whenever you lose Hao, regain half the amount lost (rounded down) and gain that much Block.
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT_POWER.title: Final Commit
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT_POWER.description: You cannot gain Block. At the end of your turn, double your Hao and remove this power.
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT_POWER.smartDescri: You cannot gain Block. At the end of your turn, double your Hao and remove this power.
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE_TEMP_STRENGTH_POWE: Extra Strength granted by Math Prince. Lose it at the end of your turn.
Extra Strength granted by Math Prince: [blue]{Amount}[/blue]. Lose it at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-XIAO_NEXT_TURN_POWER.title: Xiao Next Turn
MYSTS2MOD-XIAO_NEXT_TURN_POWER.descripti: At the start of your next turn, add 1 Xiao to your hand per stack. Cards generated by upgraded cards are also upgraded.
MYSTS2MOD-XIAO_NEXT_TURN_POWER.smartDesc: At the start of your next turn, add [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Xiao to your hand. Cards generated by upgraded cards are also upgraded.
MYSTS2MOD-CHUAN_NEXT_TURN_POWER.title: Chuan Next Turn
MYSTS2MOD-CHUAN_NEXT_TURN_POWER.descript: At the start of your next turn, add 1 Chuan to your hand per stack. Cards generated by upgraded cards are also upgraded.
MYSTS2MOD-CHUAN_NEXT_TURN_POWER.smartDes: At the start of your next turn, add [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Chuan to your hand. Cards generated by upgraded cards are also upgraded.
MYSTS2MOD-UNSPOKEN_FURY_POWER.title: Unspoken Fury
MYSTS2MOD-UNSPOKEN_FURY_POWER.descriptio: If you take unblocked damage between the start of this turn and the start of your next turn, deal {Damage} damage to ALL enemies per stack at the start of your next turn. HP loss does not count. Resolve those stacks afterward.
MYSTS2MOD-UNSPOKEN_FURY_POWER.smartDescr: If you take unblocked damage between the start of this turn and the start of your next turn, deal {Damage} damage to ALL enemies [blue]{Amount}[/blue] time(s) at the start of your next turn. HP loss does not count. Resolve those stacks afterward.
MYSTS2MOD-HIDDEN_STATE_POWER.title: Hidden State
MYSTS2MOD-HIDDEN_STATE_POWER.description: Gain 4 Dexterity and lose 2 Strength. Leaving the Hidden State reverses the Strength and Dexterity changes from this state.
MYSTS2MOD-HIDDEN_STATE_POWER.smartDescri: Gain 4 Dexterity and lose 2 Strength. Leaving the Hidden State reverses the Strength and Dexterity changes from this state.
MYSTS2MOD-OPEN_HAO_STATE_POWER.title: Hao Mode
MYSTS2MOD-OPEN_HAO_STATE_POWER.descripti: Gain 4 Strength and lose 2 Dexterity. Leaving Hao Mode reverses the Strength and Dexterity changes from this state.
MYSTS2MOD-OPEN_HAO_STATE_POWER.smartDesc: Gain 4 Strength and lose 2 Dexterity. Leaving Hao Mode reverses the Strength and Dexterity changes from this state.
MYSTS2MOD-DUAL_LIFE_POWER.title: Double Life
MYSTS2MOD-DUAL_LIFE_POWER.description: The first time each turn you switch between Hidden State and Hao Mode, draw cards equal to this power's amount.
MYSTS2MOD-DUAL_LIFE_POWER.smartDescripti: The first time each turn you switch between Hidden State and Hao Mode, draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] cards. Entering a state for the first time does not trigger this effect.
MYSTS2MOD-RHYTHM_POWER.title: Rhythm
MYSTS2MOD-RHYTHM_POWER.description: During your turn, whenever you gain or lose Hao, gain Block equal to this Power's stacks.
MYSTS2MOD-RHYTHM_POWER.smartDescription: During your turn, whenever you gain or lose Hao, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Block.
MYSTS2MOD-COMEBACK_POWER.title: Comeback
MYSTS2MOD-COMEBACK_POWER.description: At the end of this turn, if in Hidden State, Retain all Attack cards and enter Hao Mode at the start of your next turn. This power is then removed.
MYSTS2MOD-COMEBACK_POWER.smartDescriptio: At the end of this turn, if in Hidden State, Retain all Attack cards and enter Hao Mode at the start of your next turn. This power is then removed.
MYSTS2MOD-TIME_WAITS_FOR_NO_ONE_POWER.de: In Hidden State, Retain Attack cards in your Hand at turn end. In Hao Mode, Retain Skill cards in your Hand at turn end.
MYSTS2MOD-TIME_WAITS_FOR_NO_ONE_POWER.sm: In Hidden State, Retain Attack cards in your Hand at turn end. In Hao Mode, Retain Skill cards in your Hand at turn end.
